turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment metric, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are the cart-to-checkout rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the add to cart's day or the day after), cart sessions, checkout sessions and the view-to-cart rate; I can report any of those for 20 September to 3 October 2026 if you like.
